claims.t: Datadog, Inc. is an American company that provides an observability service for cloud-scale applications, providing monitoring of servers, databases, tools, and services, through a SaaS-based data analytics platform. Founded and headquartered in New York City, the company is a publicly traded entity on the Nasdaq stock exchange.

David Obstler brings more than three decades of operational finance experience, with over two decades focused on technology companies. Prior to Datadog, David served as CFO of TravelClick, where he led global financial operations. David was appointed to the board of Braze in 2021.

Sara Varni has over 15 years of experience bringing enterprise software products to market. Prior to Datadog, she served as CMO of Attentive, a leader in SMS marketing, as well as the CMO of Twilio where she bridged the developer and enterprise markets.
